title: Someone Special

pre.zh: 那个「特别的人」到底是谁？

intro: 一篇新概念式的家庭小故事：电话里一个没听清的词，在亲戚之间越传越离谱。读的时候留意 must have、might have、can't have：每个人都在猜「他到底遇见了谁」——猜的是过去的事，所以后面都跟 have + 过去分词。

sentences.en: Last week I told Mum on the phone that I was taking a day off to see a specialist.
sentences.zh: 上周我在电话里跟妈说，我要请一天假去看专科医生。

sentences.en: The line was bad, so she must have heard "someone special".
sentences.zh: 电话信号不好，她肯定是把 specialist（专科医生）听成了 someone special（一个特别的人）。

sentences.en: Well, word gets around fast in my family.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在我们家，消息传得飞快。

sentences.en: Mum told my aunt, my aunt told my uncle, and my uncle runs a shop.
sentences.zh: 妈告诉了姨妈，姨妈告诉了舅舅，而舅舅偏偏是开店的。

sentences.en: By Saturday, half the town knew, and I had dozens of messages.
sentences.zh: 到了周六，镇上一半的人都知道了，我手机里多了几十条消息。

sentences.en: "He must have met her at work," said my aunt.
sentences.zh: 「肯定是在单位认识的，」姨妈说。

sentences.en: "He might have met her online," said my teenage cousin.
sentences.zh: 「说不定是网上认识的，」我那上中学的表妹说。

sentences.en: "He's taken a day off for her, so it must be serious," said my uncle.
sentences.zh: 「都为她请假了，肯定是认真的，」舅舅说。

sentences.en: Only my sister Lily had doubts.
sentences.zh: 只有我妹妹 Lily 不信。

sentences.en: "He can't have found a girlfriend — he hasn't even bought curtains yet."
sentences.zh: 「他不可能找到女朋友——他连窗帘都还没买呢。」

sentences.en: By Sunday's video call, the whole family had got the wrong idea.
sentences.zh: 到了周日视频通话的时候，全家人都想歪了。

sentences.en: "When's the wedding?" Grandma asked.
sentences.zh: 「婚礼什么时候办？」奶奶问。

sentences.en: "I've already picked a lucky date."
sentences.zh: 「好日子我都挑好了。」

sentences.en: My uncle even offered to set me up with his friend's daughter.
sentences.zh: 舅舅还说要把他朋友的女儿介绍给我。

sentences.en: "Just in case," he said.
sentences.zh: 「以防万一嘛，」他说。

sentences.en: To my surprise, nobody listened when I tried to explain.
sentences.zh: 没想到，我想解释，根本没人听。

sentences.en: Everyone was making a fuss.
sentences.zh: 大家七嘴八舌，闹成一团。

sentences.en: Well, at least Mum looked thrilled.
sentences.zh: 好吧，至少妈乐坏了。

sentences.en: In the end, I explained in front of everyone: the "someone special" was an eye specialist.
sentences.zh: 最后，我当着所有人的面讲清楚了：那个「特别的人」，其实是眼科医生。

sentences.en: There was a long silence.
sentences.zh: 大家沉默了好一会儿。

sentences.en: "So did it go well?" Mum asked at last.
sentences.zh: 「那……看得顺利吗？」妈终于开口问。

sentences.en: "Very well," I mumbled.
sentences.zh: 「很顺利，」我小声嘟囔，

sentences.en: "Actually, the eye doctor was really nice."
sentences.zh: 「其实那位眼科医生人挺好的。」

sentences.en: "She asked if I'd like to go for a coffee next week, and I said yes."
sentences.zh: 「她问我下周要不要一起喝杯咖啡，我答应了。」

sentences.en: "Please keep it a secret."
sentences.zh: 「请替我保密。」

sentences.en: Nobody did.
sentences.zh: 结果谁也没守住秘密。

cards.note: to have a day away from work
see a specialist 看专科医生；an eye specialist 眼科医生。重音在第一个音节：SPE-cial-ist。
The line is bad. 信号不好；The line is busy. 占线。

cards.zh: 消息传开；一传十，十传百
cards.note: used to say that news spreads quickly from person to person
cards.tip: word 在这里是不可数名词，指「消息、传言」，前面不加 a 或 the；说过去的事用 word got around。
cards.example: Word got around that the company was moving offices.

cards.note: to own or manage a shop and be responsible for it
b 不发音，读 /daʊt/；have doubts about sth 对某事有疑问。
一般用复数，因为窗帘多是两片；拉上窗帘是 draw the curtains。

cards.tip: 误会的对象用 about：get the wrong idea about sb。英式过去分词是 got，美式是 gotten。
cards.example: Don't get the wrong idea — I'm only asking because I need help.

cards.note: to arrange for two people to meet because you hope they will start a romantic relationship
cards.tip: 人放在 set 和 up 中间：set me up with her；被人介绍是 be set up with sb。
cards.example: My colleague keeps trying to set me up with her cousin.

cards.tip: 可以单独放句末；后面也能接句子：just in case it rains，说的是将来也用一般现在时。
cards.example: I always save a copy of my work, just in case.

cards.note: used to say that something was not what you expected
cards.tip: 介词只能用 to：to my surprise，不说 for my surprise；换成别人就换物主代词：to her surprise。
cards.example: To my surprise, the meeting finished early.

cards.note: to get too excited or worried about something, often in a noisy way
cards.tip: 为某事大惊小怪用 about：make a fuss about sth；make a fuss of sb（英式）则是「对某人格外殷勤」。
cards.example: Please don't make a fuss — it's only my birthday.

cards.note: used to say that a bad situation has one good point; not less than
cards.tip: 在不顺心的事里找一点好处时常用，放句首、句中都可以：At least nobody was hurt.
cards.example: The flight was late, but at least we got home safely.

cards.note: after a long time, or after a lot of problems
where someone can see or hear you; in a position before someone or something
cards.tip: 别和 in the front of 搞混：in front of the car 在车的前方（车外），in the front of the car 在车里的前排。
cards.example: I hate giving feedback in front of the whole team.

cards.note: 形容词是 silent；in silence 默默地。
to happen in the way that you hoped
说得小声又不清楚，常因为害羞或不好意思；比较 whisper 是有意压低声音说悄悄话。
to not tell other people something that you have been asked not to tell
cards.tip: 要别人替某件事保密，说 keep it a secret（it 指那件事）；也可以说 keep sth secret，不加 a。
cards.example: Can you keep a secret? I'm leaving the company in June.
